sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.26
- A wine can send shoppers to the winery's own page for it. Set a "Product page link" on the wine or on a vintage in Bottle360 admin, and store cards, the cart drawer and the wine's old store address all go there. Wines without a link are unchanged.
- Every store page now gives search engines its own address and title instead of the store's front page, product details load sooner, and the store no longer loads some stylesheets twice.
